summary: Focused regression verification of SAP dual-account password lockout fix (Sep 16, 2026 incident). Both SOAP account _EMERGENTBOM (Emergent@22) and OData account UNEECOPSTEAM (UAdmin@11335) are healthy end-to-end. All 6 targeted pytest tests pass; frontend header shows green 'SAP PRD Connected'; Product ID lookup (source-of-supply-options) returns valid Production Models without any 'Could not verify' error. No new SAP auth/lockout log entries after backend restart at ~06:01 UTC.

minor.issue: Repeated HTTP 401 'Logon Error' entries from 04:58 to 06:21 UTC while SAP account was still locked. Last one at 06:21:56; first successful refresh at 06:32:10 UTC. No further failures after that. This is historical residue of the incident, not a current bug.
Transient ConnectTimeout to my431827.businessbydesign.cloud.sap at 06:50:33 UTC - network-level timeout, NOT a 401/auth issue. Unrelated to password fix; monitor if it recurs.

verification_evidence.backend_uptime_at_test: backend PID 8866 running ~34min at test start (restarted ~06:01 UTC on 2026-09-16).
verification_evidence.GET /api/bom/connection-status: HTTP 200 -> {"connected": true, "message": "Connected to SAP Business ByDesign"} (SOAP _EMERGENTBOM)
verification_evidence.GET /api/production-confirmation/source-: HTTP 200, 2 production model options returned (OData UNEECOPSTEAM)
verification_evidence.frontend_header_indicator: connection-status-indicator initially shows 'Checking SAP...' then flips to green 'SAP PRD Connected' on /production-confirmation page (visible in screenshots)
verification_evidence.frontend_product_id_flow: Typing/blurring product '36017845-A' shows 'Checking available Production Models...' and enables 'Check Stock' button; NO 'Could not verify this Product ID with SAP' error (verified via body text scan)
verification_evidence.post_restart_log_scan_for_auth_errors: grep for 'Logon failed|HTTP 401|SAP authentication failed|is locked|SAPProductionModelError|SAPSoapError' after backend restart -> only pre-06:22 stale-loop entries; no new auth failures after 06:22 UTC.

critical_code_review_comments: Background refresh loops (Supplier Portal PO cache etc.) retried every ~10min against SAP while the account was locked and were the root cause of the repeat re-lockout during the fix window. Consider adding a circuit breaker: on 3 consecutive HTTP 401 from SAP, pause the loop for e.g. 30-60min and alert, so a stale/expired password can't re-trigger SAP's account lockout policy. This is a resilience improvement, not a current blocker.
The stale 401 log spam from Supplier Portal PO cache from 04:58->06:21 should be trimmed by such a breaker; would also make future incident triage much easier.
